boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain James Madison University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Harrisonburg food stops with directly documented closing times of 11 p.m. or later, spanning campus-adjacent corridors, downtown, and the east side.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. East Market Option
cards.subtitle: A seven-day late window on East Market Street
cards.notes: Use this stop when the group needs several food formats after midnight; confirm holiday hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Burgers, chicken, chili, baked potatoes, salads, and frozen desserts remain available into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists the Harrisonburg restaurant at 1694 East Market Street and restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 2:00 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: East Market Until 3
cards.subtitle: The latest-listed Taco Bell in Harrisonburg
cards.notes: Choose the East Market address specifically—the other Harrisonburg locations currently post earlier closing times.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified late drive-thru option where the city locator distinguishes three local branches.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Harrisonburg locator lists 1680 East Market Street as open until 3 a.m., with drive-thru, delivery, and Open Late service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Harrisonburg, Virginia
cards.access_notes: The official city locator currently identifies this branch as open until 3:00 a.m.; verify the live listing before departure.

cards.title: The All-Night Saturday Table
cards.subtitle: A sit-down option on University Boulevard
cards.notes: Save this for Friday midnight or the Saturday all-night window; check the day-specific schedule before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A table-service alternative to drive-thrus, with breakfast dishes and burgers available during its documented late periods.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official Harrisonburg late-night page lists Friday service until midnight and Saturday as open 24 hours at 109 University Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Harrisonburg Late Night Food — IHOP at 109 University Blvd
cards.access_notes: Current official hours show Friday until 12:00 a.m. and continuous Saturday service; other days close earlier.

cards.title: A Downtown Slice at 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Oversized pizza slices on South Mason Street
cards.notes: Walk in for pizza rather than treating this as a bar stop; Thursday through Saturday carry the latest posted hours.
cards.short_summary: The downtown storefront provides a straightforward by-the-slice food run during its longest weekly service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny's official location page places Benny Sorrentino's at 64 South Mason Street and lists closing at 2 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours currently run until 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday and midnight Sunday–Wednesday.

cards.title: South Main Pizza After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Carryout and delivery near the south side of campus
cards.notes: Check the Thursday–Friday window before ordering; the official schedule separates business, carryout, and delivery hours.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, pasta, subs, calzones, and wings anchor a late food option along the South Main Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy Pizza's official site lists 1469 South Main Street and business, carryout, and delivery service until 2 a.m. Thursday and Friday.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule currently shows service until 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Friday and midnight Saturday.

cards.title: The 1 A.M. Weeknight Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Late delivery and carryout on East Market Street
cards.notes: Use the Harrisonburg listing when ordering; its schedule stays late all week and extends another hour on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A pizza-focused option whose posted hours cover both late weeknights and the deeper Friday–Saturday window.
cards.evidence_claim: Chanello's official locations page lists its Harrisonburg shop at 787 East Market Street, open until 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours currently end at 1:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday.

cards.title: Burgess Road Until 1
cards.subtitle: A late pizza counter close to the South Main corridor
cards.notes: Select 41 Burgess Road in the app or website before ordering so the displayed hours and fulfillment options match this shop.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, sandwiches, chicken, pasta, salads, and desserts make this a flexible multi-item order after evening events.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page identifies the shop at 41 Burgess Road in Harrisonburg and currently displays a closing time of 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 41 Burgess Rd in Harrisonburg
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently displays “Today Until 1:00 AM”; confirm the live day-specific hours when ordering.

cards.title: Port Republic's 2 A.M. Window
cards.subtitle: Late lobby hours on Thursday through Saturday
cards.notes: Check lobby versus drive-thru times before leaving; the official listing shows different schedules for the two service modes.
cards.short_summary: A familiar mixed-menu stop with mobile ordering, delivery, Wi-Fi, and a documented weekend late window.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official location page lists 1091 Port Republic Road and restaurant/lobby hours until 2 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 1091 Port Republic Rd, Harrisonburg
cards.access_notes: Official lobby hours currently extend to 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; the listed drive-thru closes at midnight those nights.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Cookie Counter
cards.subtitle: A late dessert stop on Burgess Road
cards.notes: Time this dessert run for Friday or Saturday; review the current weekly menu separately because flavors rotate.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated bakery counter adds a sweets-only choice to a board otherwise dominated by full meals and pizza.
cards.evidence_claim: Crumbl's official Harrisonburg store page lists 151 Burgess Road and Friday and Saturday hours from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Cookies and Desserts in Harrisonburg — Crumbl
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently lists an 11:00 p.m. close Friday–Saturday and a 10:00 p.m. close Monday–Thursday.

cards.title: East Market's Midnight Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: Delivery and carryout at the later local branch
cards.notes: Choose the 1550 East Market Street branch—the official city page distinguishes it from the South Main location.
cards.short_summary: The branch adds another midnight option on the east side, with pizza, wings, pasta, sides, desserts, and drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's official Harrisonburg locator identifies the 1550 East Market Street restaurant and currently marks it open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery & Carryout in Harrisonburg, VA — Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: The official Harrisonburg locator currently marks the 1550 East Market Street branch open until midnight; verify live hours before ordering.
